verdict.rationale: SendGrid is an API-first service that runs headlessly. It offers a REST v3 Web API, cURL usage, official SDKs, an SMTP service, and API-key authentication read from environment variables (process.env.SENDGRID_API_KEY), which is the standard pattern for CI secrets. Sandbox mode validates Mail Send requests without delivering email; this is a dry-run, not an isolated sandbox environment. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD integration documentation or examples (e.g. pipeline guides), a dedicated CLI, and independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: The SendGrid v3 Web API provides a REST interface to send email at scale
These instructions describe how to send your first email using cURL calls.
Sandbox mode is an optional parameter within mail_settings that validates a Mail Send request without delivering the email.
Twilio SendGrid provides an SMTP service to deliver your email using its servers.
